info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Partners-v2-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Partners Retrieval API provides access to a list of loyalty partners associated with the program. This endpoint allows users to view detailed information about each loyalty partner, including their offerings and benefits. Typical consumers of this API include mobile app developers and marketing teams who are looking to enhance user engagement through loyalty initiatives. By integrating this API, businesses can effectively manage and showcase their loyalty partnerships.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loyalty partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of available loyalty partners within the system. It can be used to understand which partners are part of the loyalty program, along with their details.
